title: Fantasy Art Article
content: Fantasy Art Magazine from Beijing, China has just published an 8-page interview feature on my new bookColor and Light.The magazine also contains work byJohn Bolton,Vincent DiFate,Chris Beatrice,Christian Pearce, andIgor Grechanyk.The image on the cover is "Alpine Princess," which I did as a portfolio  piece, and was used as the cover for the science fiction novel "Zanzibar  Cat" by Joanna Russ.
